zh.title: 沙烏地航空集團與法國盛陸銀行簽署融資備忘錄籌措客機資金
zh.summary: 沙烏地航空集團在巴黎簽署融資備忘錄；攜手盛陸銀行籌措新空中巴士客機資金
body: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空集團（Saudia Group）於2026年8月25日在法國巴黎簽署一項三方瞭解備忘錄，與沙烏地出口進口銀行（Saudi EXIM Bank）及法國盛陸銀行（Crédit Agricole CIB）合作，探討並籌劃購買新型空中巴士（Airbus）客機的融資方案。
根據協議，法國盛陸銀行作為融資與籌劃機構，將依據交付時程安排相應的購機融資結構；沙烏地出口進口銀行則作為國家出口信用機構，提供與交易相關的信用風險保險承保。
此項備忘錄由沙烏地航空集團總幹事易卜拉欣·阿爾奧馬爾、沙烏地出口進口銀行執行長薩阿德·阿爾哈爾布與法國盛陸銀行常務董事安德烈·澤爾武達奇共同簽署。該集團目前仍有60架 A321neo 與13架 A321XLR 客機等待交付。

en.title: Saudia Group Signs MoU with French Bank Crédit Agricole to Finance Airbus Aircraft
en.summary: Saudia Group signed an MoU in Paris to arrange financing for new Airbus aircraft deliveries.
body: Saudia Group signed a memorandum of understanding in Paris on August 25, 2026, with Saudi EXIM Bank and French investment bank Crédit Agricole CIB to explore and arrange financing solutions for acquiring new Airbus aircraft.

Under the agreement, Crédit Agricole CIB will act as financier and arranger to structure financing in line with delivery schedules. Saudi EXIM Bank will serve as the export credit agency, providing credit risk insurance coverage for the transactions.

The tripartite agreement was signed by Saudia Director General Ibrahim Al-Omar, Saudi EXIM Bank CEO Saad Al-Khalb, and Crédit Agricole CIB Managing Director André Zervudachi. Saudia is currently awaiting delivery of 60 Airbus A321neo and 13 Airbus A321XLR aircraft.

facts.claim: Saudia Group signed a memorandum of understanding in Paris on August 25, 2026, with Saudi EXIM Bank and Crédit Agricole CIB to arrange financing for new Airbus aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Saudia Group has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) in Paris, France, to explore and arrange financing solutions to acquire new Airbus aircraft.

facts.claim: Crédit Agricole CIB will structure and arrange the required financing, while Saudi EXIM Bank will provide credit risk insurance coverage.
facts.sourceQuote: Crédit Agricole Corporate, as financier and arranger, will structure and arrange the necessary financing for aircraft purchases in line with delivery schedules,” a statement read. “Saudi EXIM Bank, as the Kingdom’s export credit agency, will support the financing by providing insurance coverage for credit risks associated with the transactions.

facts.claim: The memorandum was signed by Ibrahim Al-Omar of Saudia Group, Saad Al-Khalb of Saudi EXIM Bank, and André Zervudachi of Crédit Agricole CIB during the French-Saudi Investment Roundtable.
facts.sourceQuote: The memorandum was signed by Director General of Saudia Group, Ibrahim Al-Omar, CEO of Saudi EXIM Bank, Saad Al-Khalb, and Managing Director of Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank, André Zervudachi.

facts.claim: Saudia's order backlog includes 60 Airbus A321neo and 13 Airbus A321XLR aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: The Saudi flag carrier is awaiting delivery of 60 A321neos, 13 A321XLRs, 21 787-10s, and 13 787-9s.
